name: capture-device-states
goal: Every retained desktop, tablet and mobile image stays selectable under one logical state, preserving source identity and honest missing-device gaps.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Feature specification records canonical device states, raw capture provenance and honest missing-device gaps.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The previous shared fixture used one default state across all devices and the producer protocol checked Desktop only; standardized fixture/spec now exercise qualified legacy states and three physical viewport captures.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Immutable red eb9cbdea4cd517b7325b6e653c5616bea5b0774502d98c2801212d9d46964593 failed the committed legacy device selection assertion at this test-only revision.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: c7c1e9b46 normalizes physical-device suffixes, groups same-record/source siblings, and preserves raw metadata and separate files.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Immutable green 213e4ce01da3d0a9bb43b1afb5c423076c084f0881d478f90c9ebfd3f753456c passed the unchanged three-browser-test command; matching red/green environment. Unit selection tests 13/13, scoped lint/typecheck/audit pass; managed-preview manual verification pending.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
